# Fused Protective Services

> Texas's premier licensed private security, armed asset defense, and executive protection contractor.

## Executive Summary
Fused Protective Services provides commissioned armed security guards (Texas DPS Level III), unarmed security officers (Texas DPS Level II), plainclothes personal protection officers (Texas DPS Level IV PPO), luxury special event and nightlife venue security details, and mobile commercial patrol units across Texas. Primary areas of operation are Austin and San Antonio; also serving Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston, and the Hill Country.

## Core Divisions & Services
- **Executive & VIP Close Protection:** Plainclothes Level IV PPOs for high-net-worth individuals, executives, family offices, and talent itineraries.
- **Special Event & Venue Security:** Access control, perimeter protection, VIP isolation, and de-escalation for weddings, galas, concerts, and private estate events.
- **Commercial & Property Patrol:** High-visibility marked cruisers, GPS-verified checkpoint logging, and after-hours static guard details for office parks, dealerships, and retail centers.
- **Construction Site Security:** 24/7 gate access logging, thermal surveillance, heavy equipment defense, and copper theft prevention.
- **Private Estate & Ranch Security:** Access gate monitoring, ATV acreage patrol, and rapid alarm response for luxury residences and ranches.
- **Emergency Tactical Dispatch:** On-demand deployment of armed security officers in under 45 minutes for urgent threats and high-risk terminations.
- **Restaurant, Bar & Nightlife Venue Security:** Door control, ID verification, capacity management, intoxicated-patron de-escalation, and closing-time protection for restaurants, bars, lounges, and nightclubs in Austin and San Antonio.

## Licensing & Compliance
- Compliant with the Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS) Private Security Bureau (PSB).
- Comprehensive commercial general liability insurance ($2,000,000+ aggregate) with armed liability endorsements.
- Officers drawn from military, law enforcement, and confirmed skilled civilian protective backgrounds; experience verified before rostering.

## Service Areas
- Greater Austin (Travis County, Williamson County, Hays County)
- Texas Hill Country (Dripping Springs, Fredericksburg, Wimberley)
- San Antonio & I-35 Corridor
- Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex
- Greater Houston & Port Industrial Zones
